item.description:
I don’t do hacking services

I’m tired of repeating this. I will not hack your Facebook, your Instagram, your ex’s account, your girlfriend’s account, your “friend’s” account, or anyone else’s. Not for money, not as a favor, not “just this once,” and not if you have a really sad story.

If anyone tells you I can do it, they lied to you, and you should not trust them. Whoever is spreading that is either trying to scam you or using my name to do it. Don’t trust them, and don’t send them money. I’m not involved in any of it.
